arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Maynard argued the lower court issued a federal judgment.
Ms. Maynard stated Congress provided for injunctive relief in the statute.
Mr. Waxman argued Congress used the word shall to mandate data sharing.
Mr. Waxman claimed applicants cannot disregard statutory mandates after using sponsor information.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Sandoz seeks to delay sharing proprietary data with Amgen. Amgen demands immediate data access to start patent litigation. The Court must interpret the statutory timeline for this exchange.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the timeline for biosimilar patent litigation. It determines when generic makers must share data. It affects the speed of biosimilar market entry. It shapes the balance between patent rights and competition.
